segments.mil7.3.5:1.1: “Bhante nāgasena,‘nāvāya tīṇi aṅgāni gahetabbānī’ti yaṃ vadesi, katamāni tāni tīṇi aṅgāni gahetabbānī”ti?
segments.mil7.3.5:1.2: “Yathā, mahārāja, nāvā bahuvidhadārusaṅghāṭasamavāyena bahumpi janaṃ tārayati,
segments.mil7.3.5:1.3: evameva kho, mahārāja, yoginā yogāvacarena ācārasīlaguṇavattappaṭivattabahuvidhadhammasaṅghāṭasamavāyena sadevako loko tārayitabbo.
segments.mil7.3.5:1.4: Idaṃ, mahārāja, nāvāya paṭhamaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
segments.mil7.3.5:2.2: evameva kho, mahārāja, yoginā yogāvacarena bahuvidhakilesaūmivegaṃ lābhasakkārayasasilokapūjanavandanā parakulesu nindāpasaṃsāsukhadukkhasammānanavimānanabahuvidhadosaūmivegañca sahitabbaṃ.
segments.mil7.3.5:2.3: Idaṃ, mahārāja, nāvāya dutiyaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
segments.mil7.3.5:3.1: “Puna caparaṃ, mahārāja, nāvā aparimitamanantamapāramakkhobhitagambhīre mahatimahāghose timitimiṅgalamakaramacchagaṇākule mahatimahāsamudde carati,
segments.mil7.3.5:3.2: evameva kho, mahārāja, yoginā yogāvacarena tiparivaṭṭa dvādasākāra catusaccābhisamayappaṭivedhe mānasaṃ sañcārayitabbaṃ.
segments.mil7.3.5:3.3: Idaṃ, mahārāja, nāvāya tatiyaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
segments.mil7.3.5:3.4: Bhāsitampetaṃ, mahārāja, bhagavatā devātidevena saṃyuttanikāyavare saccasaṃyutte –
segments.mil7.3.5:4.1: “‘Vitakkentā ca kho tumhe, bhikkhave,“idaṃ dukkhan”ti vitakkeyyātha,“ayaṃ dukkhasamudayo”ti vitakkeyyātha,“ayaṃ dukkhanirodho”ti vitakkeyyātha,“ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā”ti vitakkeyyāthā’”ti.
